customer: hey so were downsizing to just one car and i want to sell my convertable. problem is it wont start anymore, been sitting in the garage for months. can i still bring it in or what do i do?
agent: Thanks for reaching out, and sorry to hear the convertible won't start. As explained in our article "Selling a car that doesn't run," we don't buy cars that don't run or can't be driven safely to a store. Since it won't start, a local salvage buyer may be a better option for you.
